tei:div.tei:p: 'dzam bu gling pa'i rgyal rabs spyi byings kyi stong thun zur tsam bzhugs so/ /

oṃ swa sti/ sngon bsags bsod nams du mas rgyu byas zhing*/ /rigs rus cho 'brang ldan pas rkyen byas te/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel 'dzoms pas gling bzhi la/ /'khor lo'i sgyur rgyal rnams la'ang bstod par bgyi/ /spyi ru lha mi'i rjer gyur rgyal rigs la/ /rgyas par phye na sum brgya drug cu yod/ /de las bsdus na rnam pa gnyis bshad de/ /dag pa sangs rgyas rje dang ma dag sems can rje/ /sangs rgyas rje ni sku gsum 'gro don mdzad/ /sems can rje la rnam pa lngar dbye nas/ /stong gsum dbang byed spyi phud rgyal po dang*/ /sa 'dzin rgyal po phyogs skyong rgyal po dang*/ /rigs drug rgyal po 'dzam gling rgyal po dang*/ /lnga po de yang 'dzam gling sog kha'i rgyal po la/ /bskos dang gdung rgyud glo bur rgyal por bshad/ /rgyal po de gsum 'khor los sgyur rgyal rkyen/ /de la spyi phud rgyal po tshangs pa dang*/ /sa 'dzin brgya byin phyogs skyong rgyal chen bzhi/ /rigs drug rgyal po gshin rje chos rgyal dang*/ /'dzam gling gdung rgyud rgyal po mang bkur rgyud/ /'khor lo sgyur rgyal spyi bo skyes la sogs/ /gser dngul zangs lcags dbang sgyur rgyal po yin/ /bod kyi rgyal po glau bur rgyal por grags/ /bskos pa'i rgyal po phyogs bzhi'i rgyal po yin/ /rgya gar chos kyi rgyal por bsko ba ni// byin rlabs bum pa glang chen snas bzung nas/ /de yis su la dbang bskur de la bkod/ /rgya nag gtsug lag rgyal por bsko ba ni/ /rgya'i khang pa shin tu mtho ba la| |shel gyi skas btsugs su thar de la bsko/ /ge sar dmag gi rgyal por bskau ba ni/ /dpag chen bzhis mda' bzhi char phyogs bzhir 'phangs/ mda' bzhi dus su zin na de la bskau ba yin/ /stag gzig nor gyi rgyal por bskau ba ni/ /rin chen gling nas nor bu sus lon gyis/ /nor gyi bdag po de la bskau ba yin/

/bskos pa'i rgyal po bzhi'i ston pa ni/ /rgya gar rgyal po sngon sbyangs las 'phro can/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi snod du rung bas na/ /rgyal ba shākya thub pas ston pa mdzad/ /rgya nag gtsug lag dpyad kyis 'dul gzigs nas/ /mkhyen rab bdag po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis/ /gab tse sum brgya drug cu ston par mdzad/ /ge sar dmag gi 'dul bar gzigs nas su/ /lha mo pañci ka yi bu lnga brgya po/ /de 'dra dmag tu sprul nas ston pa mdzad/ /stag gzig nor gyi 'dul bar gzigs nas su/ /'phags pa nor 'dzin sku sprul ston pa mdzad/ /rgya gar chos rgyal ma rig mun pa sel/ /rgya nag rgyal po legs nyes me long ston/ /ge sar rgyal po dmag gis dgra dpung 'dul/ /stag gzig rgyal pos dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel/ /zhes bshad pa rnams rgyal rabs spyi yi stong thun zur tsam mo// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba/ PAGE 3 rgyal rabs spyi phyin gyi stong thun/ -PAGE 4--PAGE 3--PAGE 3-
